cell: logical 1x1x1 on 0.55 m grid; mount = Socket_Mount_Bottom

R4W_RocketLauncher_ROOT.style: R41_Turret_v6.1 standard (heavy industrial armour + team colour)

Socket_Mount_Bottom.role: mounting face centre, normal -Y, connects to cell (0,-1,0)

R4W_RocketLauncher_Yaw.role: Yaw: rotate around local Y only

R4W_RocketLauncher_Pitch.role: Pitch: rotate around local X only (launcher pod)

R4W_RocketLauncher_RearCover.role: rear loading cover: rotates about local X (top hinge), opens 110 deg for reload

R4W_RocketLauncher_Hatch_L.role: front blast hatch: rotates about local Y (outer hinge), opens 100 deg before launch

R4W_RocketLauncher_Hatch_R.role: front blast hatch: rotates about local Y (outer hinge), opens 100 deg before launch

R4W_RocketLauncher_Rocket_1.role: visual rocket in tube 1: Fire moves it out along local +Z then hides it (scale 0.001); Reload slides it in from the rear

R4W_RocketLauncher_Rocket_2.role: visual rocket in tube 2: Fire moves it out along local +Z then hides it (scale 0.001); Reload slides it in from the rear

R4W_RocketLauncher_Rocket_3.role: visual rocket in tube 3: Fire moves it out along local +Z then hides it (scale 0.001); Reload slides it in from the rear

R4W_RocketLauncher_Rocket_4.role: visual rocket in tube 4: Fire moves it out along local +Z then hides it (scale 0.001); Reload slides it in from the rear

MuzzleFlash.role: tube-mouth launch flash FX (tube 1) - idle scale 0.001

Rocket_Backblast.role: backblast FX at the pod rear (tube 1) - idle scale 0.001

Muzzle.role: logical rocket spawn (centre of the 2x2 pod)

Muzzle_1.role: visual tube 1 mouth (not a gameplay shot count)

Muzzle_2.role: visual tube 2 mouth (not a gameplay shot count)

Muzzle_3.role: visual tube 3 mouth (not a gameplay shot count)

Muzzle_4.role: visual tube 4 mouth (not a gameplay shot count)

visible_exits_note: 4 visible tubes (Muzzle_1..4) + 1 logical Muzzle; gameplay keeps one rocket per shot and 10-rocket ammo
notes: Fire clip launches tube 1 only; tube 1 is empty until Reload (master timeline: Fire is followed by Reload).
